lines: *Blam-blam-blam-blam-blam-blam-blam!!!!!*
The 12.7mm heavy machine gun opened fire.
Clouds of dust rose everywhere with the bangs of fierce gunfire from three powered exoskeletons.
Asagi
Hah!!!
However, Asagi dodged every single bullet with lightning speed.
Not only that, but she was skillfully guiding their lines of fire.
*Ba-ba-ba-ba-ba-ba-bang!!*
One unfortunate soldier took the stray bullets which turned him into a lump of meat.
Asagi
Having numbers isn't necessarily a good thing.
Soldier
"Ghaaaghh!!" "Gwaaaaghh!!"
Asagi had yet to even make a single strike with her sword.
She was simply dashing around with extreme speed.
That alone was enough to mercilessly direct the enemy soldiers to drown each other in friendly fire.
Giant Cyborg
Don't shoot! Use your blades!
The giant cyborg, who appeared to be the leader of the assault squad, shouted orders.
*Ka-shink!! Ka-shink!! Ka-shink!!*
The three Raiden units switched to their bladed weapons.
Then, using their mechanical drives to accelerate and close the distance all at once, they launched a close-range attack on Asagi in unison.
Asagi
Hmm. You're almost as fast as Taimanin.
Her enemies approached.
Asagi, however, was unfazed.
She nimbly evaded the blades unleashed from three directions and landed a counterstrike on one of the exoskeletons with her katana.
Asagi
Haaaaahhh!!
*Clang!!!!*
Sparks flew with a grating sound.
Asagi's blade had bounced off the exoskeleton's hard armor.
Asagi
That's quite a well-made toy.
It didn't appear to be a mere powered exoskeleton.
With the incredible speed they'd just shown and the defensive power of their armor, there was no doubt that Devildomian technologies were being used.
Asagi
(This looks pretty tough without something like Murasaki's monstrous strength.)
To make matters worse, the Raidens were not her only enemies.
Giant Cyborg
Surround her and aim at her legs! Stop that bitch!
At the command of their giant cyborg leader, the enemy soldiers started surrounding Asagi at a distance.
Being surrounded by three powered exoskeleton units and fully armed soldiers would put anyone in danger, and Asagi was not an exception.
Moreover, she had Yamamoto to protect.
Asagi
What a hassle.
Asagi
(It can't be helped, in this case. Well, so long as it's just for a little bit...)
Asagi came to an abrupt stop and slowly lowered her katana in each hand.
Giant Cyborg
Geh-heh-heh, are you giving up, old hag?
Asagi
You're not very popular with women, are you?
Asagi's figure in the cyborg's eyes began to blur.
As if the laws of physics were being warped around her.
Giant Cyborg
Wh-, what!?
If he were a Taimanin, he would have recognized...
...that overflowing from Asagi's body was a tremendous amount of demonic ki.
